body:
GRAND HARBINGER
CR 13

XP 25,600
NE Medium humanoid
Init +2, Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +18

DEFENSE

AC 26, touch 16, flat-footed 23 (+3 Dex, +10 natural, +3 deflection)
hp 200 (initial) + 150 (plated skin)
Fort +17, Ref +11, Will +5
SQ plated skin, DR 5/epic; Immune ability damage, mind-affecting effects, paralysis, poison

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee 2 claws +22 (2d6 +10 plus grab) bite (after “eternal hunger” activates) +24 (2d8 +10)
Ranged 4 spines +16 (1d10 +10/x3)

STATISTICS

Str 30, Dex 16, Con 26, Int 2, Wis 12, Cha 11
Base Atk +14; CMB +18, CMD 30
Feats Awesome Blow, Blind-Fight, Bleeding Critical, Cleave, Combat Reflexes, Great Fortitude
SQ Manifestation of Ruin

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Monstrous Form (Su)

The Grand Harbinger’s attacks count as magic and adamantine.

Spines (Ex)

The tarrasque spawn can loose a volley of four s pea r-like spines from its body as a standard action with a tos s of its head or a lash of its tail. Make an attack roll for each spine—all targets must be within 30 feet of each other. The spines have a range increment of 120 ft.

Plated Skin (Ex)

The Grand Harbinger’s plated skin has two ma in functions. First, it serves as additional hit points. He can choose to take damage dealt by other creatures to his hit points or the plated s ki n. Alternatively, he can choose to pass a save he failed. If he does this, he suffers 50 damage.

Manifestation of Ruin (Su)

The Grand Harbinger will adopt aspects of the tarrasque over the course of the fight. These aspects occur the first two mes his plated skin reaches zero hit points, when he first reaches 150 hit points, and when he reaches 50 hit points. Whenever it occurs, he selects one of the four following aspects to manifest.

Toughened Plates

The Grand Harbinger gains size and his plated skin thickens. He gains +3 AC, +75 hit points on his plated s ki n, +2d8 on melee attack damage, and body spikes. These body spikes cause 2 piercing damage to creatures that strike hi m in melee combat.

Regeneration

The Grand Harbinger heals 10 hit points at the end of every round. Additionally, he becomes immune to the 140 following conditions: blinded, deafened, frightened, petrified, and stunned. Finally, he gains a third legendary action every turn.

Magic Resistance

Magic itself struggles to be in the Grand Harbinger’s presence.

He gains SR 22. Additionally, he can reflect some spells. Any me he is targeted by a magic missile spell or a ray spell, roll 1d6. On a 5 or 6, it is reflected back at the caster.

Eternal Hunger

The Grand Harbinger’s jaw snaps open and elongates, stretching fa r beyond any human’s limit. He gains a bite attack as part of his attack roll. He also gains blinds ens e 120’ and becomes immune to the following conditions : charmed, unconscious, and fatigue.

Devour (Ex)

This standard action can only be us ed if the target is grappled. The grappled creature suffers 14d6 piercing damage. An Escape Artist check DC 20 is granted to reduce the damage to half. If the check is failed, the cultist is heal ed by half of the damage dealt by this attack (rounded down).
